Officer's narrative
At an intersection in Pasadena, Texas, Driver 1 was proceeding through the junction when Driver 2's vehicle struck
the driver's side of Driver 1's car. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee and was assessed at the scene. Passenger
was also seated in Driver 1's vehicle, and both the responding officer and the parties present confirmed that
Passenger was in the car at the time of impact. No independent witnesses observed the collision. Scene photographs
confirm several details of the vehicle positions, and the visible damage is largely consistent with the reported side
impact. The policy on Driver 1's vheicle lists Driver 1 as a person who may not drive the car. Investigators found no
evidence of earlier damage to the vehicle. It is not yet clear whether the knee injury resulted from this crash, and
medical follow-up will be needed to determine the cause.
